laws: Only a successful known P2 or P3 receipt with its complete ordered phase chain can reach save acknowledgement.
Receipt revision must equal the captured editor generation before the live dirty frontier is evaluated.
Receipt digest must equal the exact captured content SHA-256 and P2 byte count must also match.
A valid stale receipt protects newer work and never clears the later generation.
Explicit Save and Save As use the durable coordinator instead of generic atomic rename success.
Untitled and unchanged-content autosave paths obtain a fresh durable readback receipt before acknowledgement.
Renderer state consumes only a main-owned typed SAVED acknowledgement at its exact local generation.

outcomeMatrix.outcome: P2 sync, atomic publish and exact readback receipt
P3 scene and manifest commit receipt
main explicit Save and Save As durable coordinator adoption
strict receipt generation, digest, bytes and phase binding before dirty clear

residualRisks: WP201 remains responsible for one multi-artifact scene and manifest transaction; WP200 closes only generation-bound durable receipt acknowledgement.
The physical filesystem tests use isolated synthetic temporary files and do not mutate user documents or Drive state.
Other generic atomic writers remain outside the explicit Writer Save and Save As path certified by this contour.
No dependency, storage adoption, migration, SAFE_APPLY, release, signing, cloud or AI authority is added.
